subject: maths
question: 12% of the voters in an election did not cast their votes and 2% of the casted votes were declared invalid. In this election, there were only two candidates. The winner by obtaining 46% of the total registered voters defeated his opponent by 1,044 votes. What was the total number of voters registered in the election?
solution:
**Given data:**

12% did not cast their vote

2% of the total cast votes were declared invalid

The winner received 46% of the total registered votes

Winner won by 1044 votes

**Solution:**

Let the total number of voters be V

⇒ Total votes cast = V × (88/100)

The valid votes = Total votes cast × (98/100)

⇒ The valid votes = V × (88/100) × (98/100)

Votes received by winning candidate = V × (46/100)

Votes received by losing candidate = Valid votes - Votes of winner

⇒ [V × (88/100) × (98/100)] - [V × (46/100)]

According to the question

The winner defeated his opponent by 1044 votes

&rArr
